axisConvention: authoring = Blender V8 units, +X bow, +Y port, +Z up; game = (-y, z, x) * metresPerUnit (game +Z bow, +X starboard, +Y up)
notes: metresPerUnit 0.5 decided 2026-09-24 (uniform; see docs/MODULAR-SHIPS.md for the derivation). maxMiddles 3 = the bay counts Astra verified closed in Blender (0-3).
